{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chatterbox sensor component''' was produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Developed after GSI acquired several failed [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] companies, the Chatterbox boosted a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] effective communications range in order to allow for better tactical coordination.
